context.question: Who will win the 2020 US presidential election?
context.setting: Democrat Joe Biden (Scorpio Ascendant in the Vedic reckoning used by the interviewees) challenges incumbent Republican President Donald Trump; the election is on 3 November 2020. Polls favour Biden, but three Dubai-based Vedic astrologers interviewed by a newspaper disagree among themselves about the charts.

provenance.work: Gulf News, '2020 US elections: Who will be the next US president?', last updated 28 October 2020
